about._help: Short bio. paragraphs = list of paragraphs.
about.heading: About
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Aprim Regmi. I'm a backend developer based in Nepal, focused on building fast and reliable systems.

I love figuring out how things work under the hood. Most of my time goes into database architecture, caching with Redis, and making APIs as fast as possible. I build scalable backends with Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, and MongoDB to power both web and mobile apps.
I enjoy turning complex backend problems into simple, readable code, and writing about what I learn along the way.
